```{r}
pals <- list(
  blue    = c("grey88", "#14B3FF", "#2E8BE0", "#2A5DB0", "#10316E"),
  red     = c("grey88", "#FF6B6B", "#F03B3B", "#C81E1E", "#7A0C0C"),
  heat    = c("grey88", "#FDB31A", "#FB6A4A", "#E42A2A", "#A31D1D", "#67000D"),
  green   = c("grey88", "#4FD16B", "#22A53C", "#157A28", "#0A4715"),
  orange  = c("grey88", "#FFA63D", "#FB7A1E", "#E25410", "#8C2D04"),
  purple  = c("grey88", "#B26BFF", "#8A3FE0", "#6A24B0", "#3D106E"),
  teal    = c("grey88", "#2EE0C0", "#14B8A6", "#0E8074", "#0A4A44"),
  magenta = c("grey88", "#FF5CC8", "#E0289E", "#A8156E", "#5E0A3E")
)
expr_scale <- function(pal, floor = 0.03) {
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours  = pal,
    values   = c(0, seq(floor, 1, length.out = length(pal) - 1)),
    na.value = pal[1]
  )
}

```

```{r}
milo_tests_scores_df <- names(milo_hsc_cell_scores) %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    new_name <- paste0("mean_lfc_", x)
    milo_hsc_cell_scores[[x]] %>% dplyr::rename(!!sym(new_name) := "mean_lfc") }) %>%
  purrr::reduce(inner_join) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cell_id")


srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, n_nhoods >= 1 & sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 == "3")
var_feats <- FindVariableFeatures_filt(srt_sub,
                                         exclude_genes    = excluded_genes,
                                         selection.method = "vst",
                                         nfeatures        = 1000) |>
    Seurat::VariableFeatures()
 
srt_sub <- Seurat::SCTransform(srt_sub,
                      assay             = "RNA",
                      do.correct.umi    = FALSE,
                      residual.features = var_feats)
VlnPlot(srt_sub,
        features = "mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT",
        group.by = "sample.name",
        alpha = 0.2,
        sort = TRUE)
srt_sub <- Seurat::GroupCorrelation(srt_sub,
                                    assay = "SCT",
                                    slot = "scale.data",
                                    var = "mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT",
                                    do.plot = FALSE)

srt_sub[["SCT"]]@meta.features%>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_symbol")%>%
  filter(! gene_symbol %in% sex_degs,
         !is.na(mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT_cor))%>%
  mutate(gene_symbol = ifelse(mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT_cor>=0.3 | mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT_cor< -0.2,
                              gene_symbol,
                              ""),
         r = rank(mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT_cor))%>%
  ggplot(aes(r,
             mean_lfc_mChNeg_vs_WT_cor,
             label = gene_symbol))+
  geom_point(pch = 21,
             fill = "black", 
             color = "white")+
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               colour = "black", 
               linewidth = 0.5, 
               lty = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(min.segment.length = 0,
                           segment.color = scales::alpha("black", 0.5))
```

```{r}
cl <- "2"
cat("##", cl, "\n\n")
df_cl <- filter(volcano_df , cluster == cl)
p <- ggplot(df_cl, aes(x = log_fc, y = neg_log_p)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,                    colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_allvsall, logfc_allvsall), colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_allvsall),        colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = ~filter(.x, !sig),
             aes(size = max_rate),
             fill = "grey80", colour = "white", shape = 21, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = ~filter(.x, sig),
             aes(fill = comparison, size = max_rate),
             colour = "white", shape = 21, alpha = 0.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data         = ~top_n_volcano_sig(.x, n = 100),
    aes(label    = feature, colour = comparison),
    size         = 2.5, max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE,
    segment.size = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey60"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data         = ~top_n_volcano_notsig(.x, n = 100),
    aes(label    = feature),
    color = "grey60",
    size         = 2.5, max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE,
    segment.size = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey60"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values   = comp_cols, name = "Comparison") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = comp_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Max expression\nrate", range = c(0.3, 2)) +
  facet_wrap(~comparison, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "log FC", y = "-log\u2081\u2080 (padj)", title = paste("Cluster", cl),
       caption = "Dashed: |log FC| = logfc_allvsall, padj = padj_allvsall  |  Labels: top 20 significant genes ranked by |log FC| + -log\u2081\u2080(padj)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p)
cat("\n\n")

```

    as.matrix() %>%
